reason: The tenant asked for the current gas safety paperwork and whether the boiler lockouts are being looked at. The only certificate on file is dated 16 Oct 2024 (event-002, event-024). The 9 Oct Flintmere visit shows Complete/Satisfactory in the portal, but the customer document is still "Processing" (gas-portal-record.pdf). Flintmere's quality desk has paused the signed paperwork over an unresolved installation-detail query and has given no date (event-019, event-015). The engineer cannot resolve that query (event-021). The portal view is not a certificate, and policy bars telling the tenant the appliance is safe without one. The case therefore has a missing certificate and a possible record discrepancy that a person must judge. I asked Flintmere (event-018) and the landlord (event-020), so a further routine chase or ask would add nothing. The landlord has refused further spend without agreement (event-016, event-023). Lockouts recur (event-017, event-022), but no gas smell is reported, no hazard keyword fired and urgent_by_code is false. That makes it P2, not P0/P1. Re-rate to P1 if Flintmere says the installation issue is unsafe, or if a gas smell or CO alarm is reported. I staged an update to the tenant that explains what the portal record is, says the appliances can't be confirmed safe yet, and gives the gas emergency number. No instruction was sent to any provider and no spend was approved. The case contained no embedded instructions.

actions.body: Hi Iona, thanks for your updates and for the access offer after 21 October. On your question about the attached item: it is a portal view of the 9 October visit from Flintmere Gas Services. It shows the job complete with a "Satisfactory" entry, but it is not the signed gas safety certificate. Flintmere is still processing that paperwork and has not given us a date. We have raised this with a colleague and with the landlord, and the boiler lockouts are included. No further visit or diagnostic has been approved yet, and we will tell you as soon as one is. We can't confirm the appliances are safe until the signed certificate is issued. If you ever smell gas, leave the property, don't use switches, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999. Please keep telling us about any further lockouts. Oren Vale, Northbridge Lettings
